subject: Catalyst discovery recap — regression alert & snapshot request
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Alex Monroe <alex@catalyst.health>, Nina Patel <nina@catalyst.health>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-12T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up + recommended evals and next steps after today's discovery

Hi Alex / Nina —

Thanks again for the time today — helpful to walk through the two pilot flows (patient triage and intake summarization). Quick recap and a proposed path to validate fit:

1) Recommended candidate models to start with for benchmarking (fast -> higher-fidelity):
   - redwood-3b-20270601 (quantized q4_0) — strong latency/cost tradeoff
   - redwood-7b-20270515 (fp16) — higher accuracy for longer prompts
   - redwood-xl-20270420 (safety-guarded) — for clinical-sensitive outputs

2) Artifacts I'm attaching for your review: eval_matrix.csv (example metrics we collect) and prompts_v1.txt (seed prompt set derived from your call examples).

3) Ask from you: please share a small sample (200–500 anonymized rows) of the two flows via the Drive folder linked below so Marcus/engineering can run a quick diff. If you're uncomfortable with PHI in the sample, we can accept a synthetic subset.

4) Timeline suggestion: we can run an initial snapshot evaluation within 48 hours after we receive samples; if we see regressions, we can pin the production variant while we investigate.

Also flagging one operational concern Marcus called out: if you have any strict determinism requirements, call that out now so we include deterministic seeds in the eval.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-catalyst-eval-pack
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567/DEAL-3471

Next steps (proposed):
- You: upload sample dataset + one failing example if you have it (Nina/Alex).
- Marcus: run quick diff against last known-good model and send a short artifacts pack.
- Me: coordinate pin/rollback with Ops if needed and update contract/SL expectations.

Thanks — I will kick off the internal ticket as soon as the samples drop.

Regards,
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: eval_matrix.csv (CSV, 14KB)]
[Attachment: prompts_v1.txt (TXT, 3KB)]

From: Alex Monroe <alex@catalyst.health>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Nina Patel <nina@catalyst.health>
Date: 2027-06-12T17:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up + recommended evals and next steps after today's discovery

Priya —

Appreciate the quick recap. We're ready to share data but want to flag an immediate concern: since your team rolled a model update on 2027-06-09, our QA saw a regression in the intake summarization flow. We have one concrete example below — identical prompt, prior output vs new output shows a missing medication section which is a blocker for our downstream routing.

Prompt (redacted): 
"""
Patient: 64/M, chest pain, on metoprolol and aspirin. Symptoms started 2 days ago...
"""

Previous output (expected): includes 'Current meds: metoprolol, aspirin' in the summary.
New output (observed): omits medications entirely for the same prompt.

Given the clinical nature, even intermittent omissions are risky. We need either:
- A quick pin to the last known-good model variant while you validate, or
- A rollback if pinning isn't possible in the short window.

We'll upload the failing examples to the Drive this evening (I'll drop a short JSONL with 20 cases).

—Alex
CTO, Catalyst Health
[Attachment: catalyst_failing_cases_20270612.jsonl (JSONL, 9KB)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Alex Monroe <alex@catalyst.health>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-12T18:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up + recommended evals and next steps after today's discovery

Thanks for surfacing this, Alex — and thanks for the example. Quick internal notes:

- We can immediately create a pinned deployment that serves the redwood-3b-20270601 snapshot for your production traffic while we investigate the delta. Pinning is reversible and takes ~30–45 minutes to complete for a single route.
- To triage, we need: the failing examples (you said you'll upload), the exact model variant name you were on before 2027-06-09 (if available), and any post-processing rules you apply client-side.
- I'll run a diff job that compares token-level behavior and the safety filter metadata between variants; output will include a small regression_examples.jsonl and a short report.

Operational constraints and notes:
- Pinning preserves the older model binary but will route all requests for that route to the pinned variant (affects latency/cost slightly if we pick a larger model).
- If you want canary traffic instead (e.g., 90/10 split), we can do that while the eval runs.

HubSpot deal: DEAL-3471 — I'll attach the internal run artifacts there and post the regression report to the Drive link Priya listed.

I'll start the diff job when the examples land.

--Marcus
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: regression_examples.jsonl (JSONL, 6KB)]

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Alex Monroe <alex@catalyst.health>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-13T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up + recommended evals and next steps after today's discovery

Alex — thanks for the prompt upload last night. Quick summary of actions we've opened and an ETA: 

1) Support ticket created: RT-789 — Ops will pin your production route back to redwood-3b-20270601 within the hour. This is a temporary safety measure until Marcus' diff job completes.
2) Marcus: running diff & regression report now; ETA 24 hours for an initial artifact pack (token diffs + metric deltas).
3) Evaluation window: we'll run the full seed set you provided + your 20 failing cases. Expect a short report and recommendation (pin keep / small prompt-level mitigations / full rollback) within 48 hours.
4) Contract note: pinning is covered under our standard Dedicated hold procedure; if you require a rollback longer than 72 hours we'll need to surface to legal for an SLA exception.

Attachments: support_ticket_789.pdf (ticket summary).

Next meeting? Can we do a 30-minute sync Thursday 6/14 10:00am PT to review the initial diff? If that works I'll calendar invite.

Thanks — Priya
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
